stations.title: Effie
stations.say: Why did Nell pay so little?
stations.note: A big order, a small bill.

stations.title: Lorcan's tests
stations.text: Eight egg tests, all of small orders.

stations.title: Nell
stations.say: Every box on the bill, thanks.

captions: Effie asks why Nell Hollis paid far less than the price list says for her Friday order.
Lorcan's tests try the same few small orders again and again, and none of them fails.
You cut Nell's order down to the smallest test that fails, fix the bill, then pick cases.
Now every box on the bill is paid for, and each egg price has a test of its own.
Same price list, fewer tests, and each one proves something the others do not.
